title: Namespacing + scope:global ADR conflict surfacing
purpose: Cover blueprint-contributed id namespacing and the scope:global ADR conflict-detection path.

testCases.description: prefix-family ids gain a kebab-slug prefix on stamp
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/namespace.test.js::stampId: bare prefix-family id gains the slug as PREFIX

testCases.description: suffix-family ids gain a kebab-slug suffix on stamp
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/namespace.test.js::stampId: bare suffix-family id gains the slug as SUFFIX

testCases.description: add refuses on scope:global ADR topic collision
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/apply.test.js::applyBlueprint: scope:global ADR conflict across two applied blueprints refuses the second add (AC-1002-2)

testCases.description: conflict report leads with per-side title + decision headers and names four honest resolution paths with actual blueprint slugs substituted (Phase 3.5 reshape)
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/conflicts.test.js::renderConflictReport: leads with per-side headers (topic in parens) and names four honest resolution paths (Phase 3.5)

testCases.description: namespaced non-global TACs do not conflict

shipped SPA + REST option-3 verbatim-from-refused-state money probe: fresh scaffold; add spa; add rest (refused with the reshaped message); follow option 3 EXACTLY as printed (`rcf blueprint supersede errorEnvelope --incoming <rest>` and `rcf blueprint supersede authModel --incoming <rest>`) with ZERO prep; then re-run `rcf blueprint add <rest>` and verify co-residence + honour
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::shipped SPA + REST: option 3 executes VERBATIM from the refused-add state (rev-3 P1-1, Baz ruling on the conflict-pair supersede precondition)

testCases.description: rcf blueprint add --reason attaches the ruling text to every resolutions[] record on that add
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::rcf blueprint add --reason: reason lands on every resolution record (rev-2 P1-2)

testCases.description: whitespace-only --reason on add refused at the writer edge (exit 2, no record written)
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::rcf blueprint add --reason: whitespace-only reason is refused at the writer edge (rev-2 P1-2)

testCases.description: duplicate --resolve for the same topic keeps the first declaration, drops the rest, and warns on stderr
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::rcf blueprint add --resolve: duplicate topic dedupes with a stderr warning; only one record persists (rev-2 P3-b)

testCases.description: --resolve validation error carries the CLI's single '[error] blueprint add: ' prefix — the underlying rcfError message MUST NOT prepend its own 'blueprint add: '
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::rcf blueprint add --resolve: validation error carries no doubled prefix (rev-2 P3-a)

testCases.description: conflict rendering + --json shape carry title + one-sentence decision on BOTH sides (incoming read from disk, existing read from tree)
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::conflict enrichment is symmetric: incoming side carries title + decision read off the blueprint contribution file (rev-2 nit)

testCases.description: ADR-010 chain-level decision on record: shipped camelCase topics are accepted verbatim on manifest.resolutions[].topic; the ADR id tail is kebab-ified; no rcfError names 'kebab slug' on any non-whitespace topic
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::shipped SPA + REST: option 3 executes VERBATIM from the refused-add state (rev-3 P1-1, Baz ruling on the conflict-pair supersede precondition)

testCases.description: every error path in supersede.js exits at the CLI with exactly one `[error] blueprint supersede: ` prefix; the doubled `blueprint supersede: blueprint supersede:` string never appears
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::rcf blueprint supersede: every rcfError message lands with exactly one `[error] blueprint supersede:` prefix (rev-3 mechanical P1)
